title: service-settings: Setup → AI's "Reset to environment defaults" button has no translation in zh-CN, ja-JP or es-ES, so it renders in English beside its translated sibling "测试连接"
body:
Filing-gate: ① product defect · reach: Setup → AI 与 Embedder in a zh-CN session, as admin
Reader: objectstack triage seat → the lane that owns `packages/services/service-settings`; the fix is a missing `actions.reset` key in three translation files (plus whatever lets `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` miss it)
Duplicate search: semantic search "AI settings Reset to environment defaults button untranslated zh-CN" in objectstack, incl. closed → 1 hit, #3370 (closed, the general extraction gate for action labels). Nothing names this button.

Measured during an exploratory showcase walkthrough on 2026-10-23: objectstack `main` b9c7a8f (`PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, stock showcase), objectui `main` 6fb31dc console (Vite dev, :5180), locale zh-CN.

## What happens

On Setup → AI 与 Embedder (zh-CN), the page heading, the groups and the "测试连接 / 测试 Embedder" buttons are all in Chinese, but the reset button reads **Reset to environment defaults**.

## Where

- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts` declares `{ type: 'action_button', id: 'reset', label: 'Reset to environment defaults', … }`.
- `translations/zh-CN.ts` → `ai.actions` has `test` and `test_embedder` but no `reset`.
- `ja-JP.ts` and `es-ES.ts` have no `reset` key either. I counted occurrences of `reset:` below each bundle's `ai:` block, and every bundle had 0.

## Expected

`ai.actions.reset.label` is present in every shipped locale. If `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` is meant to catch manifest action buttons, it also flags this one. That it stayed green looks like a gap in the test.
